sections.heading: Your know-how. Put to work.
sections.text: THE NEXT WAY TO WORK STARTS WITH YOU Your know-how. Put to work. Turn the way you work into digital work that runs your way. Just describe what you know. swaibian one takes it from there. Describe a use case just like you would explain it to a colleague. swaibian one uses AI to translate your knowledge into everything needed to run it: a digital expert team, an automated workflow, and a dashboard for each result. swaibian one is a multi-agent workflow system — an innovative and unique way to build, execute and maintain digital knowledge work. sections.heading: As natural as explaining it to someone.
sections.text: START WITH WHAT YOU KNOW As natural as explaining it to someone. You bring the experience. The authoring team inside swaibian one helps you turn it into something you can use. Tell it your way Make it yours Put it to work You know the details that matter. Describe the work, the checks you make, and what a good result looks like. The authoring team asks questions to help you capture the little things, too. “When a customer asks for a quote, I check what they need, note what’s missing, and prepare a reply.” An example of what you can create.

sections.heading: A new case. A familiar way of working.
sections.text: FROM KNOWING HOW TO GETTING IT DONE A new case. A familiar way of working. Once your Use Case is ready, bring it a real piece of work. A customer request. A bid to review. A candidate to assess. Your digital experts follow the process you’ve shaped. Bring a real case Follow the progress Review your result Follow the progress, review the result, and decide what happens next. One Task. One Dashboard. A clear view of the case in front of you.

sections.heading: Your work changes. Your Use Case can come with you.
sections.text: MADE FOR THE WAY YOU KEEP LEARNING Your work changes. Your Use Case can come with you. A new rule. A better question. Something you’ve learned from the last case. Describe the change in the same conversation and refine your Use Case for the work ahead. And after each Task, run a retrospective: the authoring team reviews how the case really went, so your next one starts even stronger. “For the next requests, also check whether the customer needs installation.” Review the change. Keep what works. Build on what you know.
